description.en: Guards watch the palace approaches. Beyond the gate, raised voices carry across the courtyards.
description.zh-CN: 卫兵守着通往王宫的道路。城门后，喧闹声穿过一座座庭院传来。

神情激昂，状若癫狂.en: Ptah brings word of fighting inside the palace.
神情激昂，状若癫狂.zh-CN: 卜塔带来了王宫内发生冲突的消息。

阿九断臂.en: Cleopatra's left arm was badly wounded. Strength -30; Focus +30. Seek Imhotep at Crane Peak.
阿九断臂.zh-CN: 克娄巴特拉左臂重伤。臂力-30，定力+30。去鹤峰寻找伊姆霍特普。

打败崇祯皇帝。.en: Defeated Ramesses II and escaped with Cleopatra.
打败崇祯皇帝。.zh-CN: 击败拉美西斯二世，与克娄巴特拉离开王宫。

text.en: The outer gates have fallen. There's fighting in the palace!
text.zh-CN: 外城门失守了。王宫里也打起来了！

text.en: Ramesses, the gates have fallen. Leave while there's still a way out.
text.zh-CN: 拉美西斯，城门已经失守。趁还有路可走，离开这里。

text.en: Stay with him. Get him beyond the fighting.
text.zh-CN: 你跟着他，带他远离交战的地方。

text.en: Yes, Your Majesty. Are you coming with us?
text.zh-CN: 是，陛下。您也和我们一起走吗？

text.en: With him? You would walk out while my palace burns?
text.zh-CN: 和他？我的王宫正在燃烧，你却要就这样离开？

text.en: I'm asking you to leave it alive. The throne isn't worth this.
text.zh-CN: 我是在劝你活着离开。一个王座，不值得这样。

text.en: Your word. You'll stay at my side.
text.zh-CN: 向我保证。你会留在我身边。

text.en: I'll see you safely out. I won't stay for your throne.
text.zh-CN: 我会护送你平安离开。但我不会为你的王座留下。

text.en: I built a kingdom. You would have me leave with nothing?
text.zh-CN: 我建立了一个王国，你却要我两手空空地离开？

text.en: (He swings at Cleopatra. She twists aside, but the blade catches her left arm.)
text.zh-CN: （他挥剑劈向克娄巴特拉。她侧身闪避，剑锋仍划中了左臂。）

text.en: (Horus forces Ramesses back. Cleopatra clutches her badly wounded left arm.)
text.zh-CN: （荷鲁斯逼退拉美西斯。克娄巴特拉紧按着重伤的左臂。）

text.en: You struck the person trying to save you. Give me one reason to let you walk away.
text.zh-CN: 她想救你，你却对她下手。给我一个放你走的理由。

text.en: No. Horus, don't. I won't trade this wound for an execution.
text.zh-CN: 不。荷鲁斯，别这样。我不想用这道伤，换来一场处决。

text.en: (He lowers his blade.) For you. We're getting out of here.
text.zh-CN: （他放低剑锋。）看在你的份上。我们现在就离开。

text.en: I need a healer. Please—let's go.
text.zh-CN: 我需要找人疗伤。走吧，求你了。

text.en: Imhotep. We need to find Imhotep.
text.zh-CN: 伊姆霍特普。我们得去找伊姆霍特普。
